visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Detailed close-up of a golden-brown baked papaya dish filled with melted cheese and seafood chunks. A fork lifts a portion, showing long, thin strands of gooey cheese stretching. The dish is presented in a brown woven basket with green leaves and a small calamansi fruit on the side. (2) A top-down shot features a hand hovering over a pot of boiling water on a stove. A small dish of white salt is poured in. Pink tongs then drop several pink-orange cubes of salmon into the bubbling water. The lighting is bright and even across the kitchen counter. (3) Scallops and sliced squid pieces are added to the pot along with the salmon cubes. The cook uses pink tongs to stir the ingredients gently as they cook in the simmering water. The black pot provides a high-contrast background for the white and orange seafood. (4) Cooked seafood is removed from the pot using a metal slotted spoon and placed into a clear glass bowl. Shredded yellow cheese and creamy white mayonnaise are added to the bowl. A person uses a spoon to mix the ingredients thoroughly on a light wooden table surface. (5) A deseeded, halved ripe orange papaya is placed on a white plate. Hands fill the center cavity with the prepared seafood and cheese mixture. An extra layer of shredded cheese is sprinkled by hand over the top to ensure a thick crust. (6) The stuffed papaya is slid into a small black oven on a metal rack. Inside, the orange heating element glows as the cheese topping begins to bubble and brown. The video ends with a final hero shot of the steaming, finished culinary creation.
